description: Vectorae is an AI outbound sales tool for agencies and B2B service firms: it researches your market, finds and verifies business contacts, writes one-to-one emails, sends on a schedule you approve each day, and books meetings.
tagline: AI outbound sales for agencies and B2B service firms

fit.name: Agencies
fit.body: Marketing, web and design agencies where the founder still does the selling and the pipeline stalls whenever client work gets busy.

fit.name: B2B service firms
fit.body: Staffing and recruiting agencies, consultancies and fractional experts who sell to other businesses and have no sales team yet.

fit.name: Local businesses with business clients
fit.body: Commercial cleaning, facilities, HVAC and fire protection companies looking for property managers, offices and other business accounts nearby.

not_fit: Selling to consumers or homeowners. Vectorae only finds people at companies.
Emailing a list you already have. Leads come from Vectorae's own sourcing; you cannot import them.
High-volume sending. By default each mailbox sends at most 100 emails a day.

status_labels.off_by_default: Built, switched off by default, available on request
status_labels.simulated_only: Built and tested only against simulated services; not live yet
status_labels.unconfirmed: Built and switched on, but not yet confirmed working end to end in production

capabilities.name: Writing each email for one person
Sending email from your Gmail account after daily approval
Stripe checkout (paying for a plan online)

limits: By default a newly connected Gmail account sends 10 emails on its first day, adds 10 a day, and stops at 100 a day.
Leads come only from Vectorae's own sourcing; you cannot import a contact list as leads.
Automatic sending waits each day until the account owner approves it.
compliance_features: Adds your business identity, an unsubscribe link and one-click unsubscribe headers to every email.
Suppresses a person who unsubscribes or replies "stop" on email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and phone.
Re-checks the suppression list right before every send.
Holds high-risk messages in a send-review queue for your approval.
Leaves out the open-tracking pixel for leads in the EU, EEA or UK.
Lets you erase a prospect, download your data and delete your account.
